coverage.toolbarHint: Plugin & system text outside the standard extraction
coverage.title: Text coverage
coverage.description: Player-visible text outside the standard extraction (plugin settings, System lists, map names…). Each option says where the text appears and what enabling it changes. Anything that would break the game cannot be enabled.
coverage.unsupported: This engine has no optional text categories.
coverage.nothingFound: No additional player-visible text was found.

stateHint.verified: Display-only text that no plugin, script or note tag uses as an identifier.
stateHint.linked: Used as an identifier elsewhere; Hoshi2Star rewrites every reference in the same export and verifies it.
stateHint.blocked: Used as an identifier somewhere Hoshi2Star cannot update. Translating it would break the game, so it stays in the original language.

coverage.references: Used as an identifier in {{count}} place(s)

constraint.no_escape_codes: Plain text only: codes like \C[n] or \FS[n] would be shown literally
constraint.plain_text_value: Must stay plain text: the plugin turns true/false, numbers and JSON into other types
constraint.keke_skill_type: One word: no spaces, `,` `/` `>` `:` or ASCII digits, and different from every other skill type
constraint.keke_tag_field: No `,` or `>` (they would break the note tag)
constraint.keke_no_spaces: Spaces are removed by the plugin ("Whip Attack" → "WhipAttack")

textFit.toolbarHint: Wrap dialogue and descriptions to the game's text boxes at export
textFit.title: Text fitting
textFit.description: Lays translated dialogue and descriptions out to the game's real text boxes when you export, measured with the game's own font. Your translations themselves are never changed.
textFit.enableDialogueHint: Messages in maps, common events and battles.
textFit.enableDescriptionsHint: Item, skill, weapon and armor descriptions (2-line help box) and actor profiles.
textFit.lineBreaksKeep: Keep my line breaks, split long lines
textFit.overflow: When a text is too long for its box

textFit.dialogueFontSizeHint: Empty: the game's size ({{size}} px). The font size chosen when exporting also sets it.

textFit.help: Help box: {{width}} px of text, 2 lines.
textFit.fontMeasured: Font: {{file}} at {{size}} px, measured from the game's font file.
textFit.shrinkNote: Shrinking fits more words on each line; it only adds a 5th line at 19 px or less, because the first line of a box always keeps its full height.
textFit.warnings: Plugins that may change the text layout
textFit.missing: Characters the game font lacks (drawn with a fallback font, widths estimated): {{chars}}
